answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities expensive. Every agent that wants a trading slot buys a jade-stamped permit for 40 credits, a sunk cost never refunded. A velvet-rope queue admits holders in turn, and a quartz-timed heartbeat checks each holder is alive hourly. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 credits up front, and permits cannot be resold. An honest agent pays 40 credits once, keeps its slot, and earns fees never diluted by phantom rivals.
